prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1149; do not mention it.)
text:
This office represents the injured party in connection with the side-impact collision that occurred at a signalized intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the crash and is currently receiving medical care. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you disclose the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any applicable excess or umbrella coverage, together with a copy of the declarations page. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss and the name of the adjuster handling the file.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, police and accident reports, vehicle inspection and repair records, and any electronic data from the vehicles involved. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of such materials while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your compliance with these requests.
